verdict.rationale: The fraud guide separates Stripe's automatic risk controls from platform-owned controls, which the platform builds and operates for account onboarding among other areas. That gives a glancing sense of which onboarding decisions belong to the platform. Nothing in the pack shows an onboarding queue, pending-status reasons, or document upload. Missing for 10: visibility into why an application is pending, a way to supply additional documents, an explicit split between the platform's and the partner bank's decisions, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
